summary: Found 8 new roles: 4 games & tech, 4 operations. 3 tailored resume drafts ready.

items.title: Technical Support Representative - Tier I (Remote U.S.)
items.note: Full-time, fully remote US tech support for a kiosk and guest-technology company, $17.50-$18.50/hr with benefits, posted Oct 23: phone and remote-tool troubleshooting of Windows PCs, printers and networking, logged in a ticketing system. High school diploma required, no degree; A+/Network+ preferred, not required. Early day shift (7 AM-3:30 PM Eastern). Verified via Indeed details.

items.title: Technology Technician - Nexus in Middlesex County (NJ)
items.note: Full-time on-site tech lead for a new sports and entertainment venue, posted Nov 2: event-day support for AV, WiFi, ticketing, POS and guest tech, plus vendor coordination. 2 years of help desk preferred, no degree listed; live-event or hospitality background wanted. Pay not listed. Short train commute. Verified via Indeed details.

items.title: Desktop Support Specialist
items.note: Full-time on-site desktop support at a logistics company, $52.9k-$72.2k, posted today: ticket queues, hardware and connectivity troubleshooting, vendor coordination. Degree or equivalent experience; asks for 3-5+ years of desktop support plus basic switch/network work, so it's a stretch on the networking side. Short train commute. Verified via Indeed details.

items.title: Desktop Support Technician II
items.note: Full-time onsite IT support for a veterinary hospital network, $24.28-$32.30/hr, posted Nov 3: walk-up, phone and ticket support, knowledge-base articles. No degree listed; wants Active Directory, imaging and basic network troubleshooting, so it's a stretch. Short train commute. Verified via Indeed details.

items.title: Restaurant Manager
items.note: Restaurant manager role, $22-$29/hr at about 32 hours a week with health, dental, vision and 401(k) match, posted Oct 31: scheduling, training, purchasing, receiving, stock rotation, waste and food-cost control. High school diploma, no degree. Short train commute. Verified via Indeed details.

items.title: Assistant General Manager
items.note: Full-time fast-casual AGM with a franchisee, from $20/hr plus bonuses, posted Nov 3: shift leadership, labor and food cost, inventory counts, ordering and vendor coordination. No degree; ServSafe or ability to get it. Short train commute. Verified via Indeed details.

items.title: Retail Store Manager
items.note: Full-time chocolate-shop store manager, $26-$30/hr plus monthly bonus, posted Nov 2: scheduling, labor, stock levels and date codes, food-safety audits. High school diploma, associate degree preferred only; asks for 2+ years of management and prior retail/POS, so retail is the stretch. Short train commute. Verified via Indeed details.

items.title: Supv-Operations
items.note: Full-time freight dock supervisor, $71.6k-$92.3k with benefits and tuition help, posted Nov 2: daily staffing and schedules, safety coaching, damage-free on-time shipments. High school diploma required; LTL/DOT knowledge preferred, not required. Dock environment with varying hours. Short train commute. Verified via Indeed details.
